# ChongGrok AI Membership Guides

> Unified directory for independent ChatGPT, SuperGrok, Claude and Gemini membership subscription, payment troubleshooting and account-status guides. ChongGrok is not affiliated with OpenAI, xAI, X, Anthropic or Google.

## Scope and safety

- Membership subscriptions only; no API credits.
- No SMS verification or bulk registration. ChatGPT, Grok and Claude do not offer ready-made accounts; Gemini is the only product with a separate ready-made annual account option.
- Passwords, email verification codes and recovery codes are not requested.
- ChatGPT session credentials are sensitive and should be refreshed after completion.
- Legacy Grok User ID is an account identifier. X Subscription redemption uses Grok SSO, a sensitive login credential; these are different requirements.
- ChongGrok does not handle conversion from legacy memberships to The X Subscription; use the provider's official Unify flow.
- The current ChongGrok Claude service is personal Pro monthly assistance through iOS in-app purchase, not Max. Confirm account, region and required information on the live product page before payment.
- Gemini own-account assistance is confirmed case by case and no fixed credential is claimed. Gemini also has a separate ready-made annual account option; the two fulfillment paths must not be conflated.
- No online service is risk-free; no guaranteed account outcome is claimed.
